recipes.name: One-Bowl Soft Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*.
In a large bowl, cream together the coconut oil and brown sugar with a fork**.
Then add the milk, maple syrup, vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Mix well. The mixture might look a bit clumpy, and that's okay.
Sift the flour into the bowl and stir until partially combined.
Lastly, fold the chopped chocolate through the dough. Be careful to not over-mix.
Scoop up 1 Tbsp of the dough at a time, and roll them into balls. Place on the baking tray about 2 inches (5 cm) apart as the cookies will spread.
To decorate, add a few bits of chopped chocolate to the top of each cookie if desired.
Bake on the centre rack of the oven for 12 to 13 minutes, or until lightly golden. Let them set on the baking tray for a minute before transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** The coconut oil needs to be solid for this recipe, and not melted. If the oil is soft, place it in the fridge until hardened.
Storage Store in an airtight container on the counter for up to 4 days.
